outline:
本課程除了讓學生扮演專家進行論文初稿審查，藉此了解專家審查時所注意的構面以及取得專家意見的即時回饋之外，也將透過數位學習相關國際研討會、國際期刊的審查標準，增進自我的論文評析技巧。
In this course, students will have to play the roles as reviewers in order to discern the quality of papers and to receive immediate feedback from experts. In addition, with the preview of the examination criteria on papers submitted to international conferences and journals related to e-learning, learners are supposed to contribute significant suggestions and hence enhance their ability of reviewing papers.
schedule:
週次(week) 進度
1 講解教學計畫與相關要求(Introduction)
2 數位學習相關國際研討會、國際期刊的審查標準(Criteria for reviewing )
3 評析重點：摘要 (Abstract)
4 評析重點：緒論I (Introduction)
5 評析重點：緒論II (Introduction)
6 評析重點：文獻回顧I (Literature review)
7 評析重點：文獻回顧II (Literature review)
8 評析重點：研究方法I (Research Methods))
9 期中考週 (Midterm exam week)
10 評析重點：研究方法II (Research Methods)
11 評析重點：結果與發現I (Results and findings)
12 評析重點：結果與發現II (Results and findings)
13 評析重點：討論與結論I (Discussion and conclusions)
14 評析重點：討論與結論II (Discussion and conclusions)
15 評析重點：整體性I (Overall)
16 評析重點：參考文獻 (Reference)
17 期末報告 (Final reports)
18 期末考週 (Final exam week)
scorePolicy:
1. 出席、課堂參與(Class participation and discussion)：20%
2. 線上學習活動(Online learning activity)：35%
3. 期末評析報告(Final reports)：45%
materials: 國際研討會論文(International conference papers)、SSCI國際期刊論文(SSCI Journal papers)
